title: Agentic Development Training: Beginner Recording Now Available — Plus What’s Coming Next
summary: A beginner-level recording on agentic development workflows for Business Central is now available, covering core concepts and AI-assisted automation techniques. The post also outlines intermediate and expert live training sessions scheduled for April and May, with flexible purchasing options including individual recordings and bundle discounts.
key_points: Beginner recording covers agentic concepts, building automated BC workflows, and getting practical value from AI tools
Intermediate and expert sessions run live on Teams with Q&A across three time zones to accommodate global developers
All recordings are DRM-free with permanent ownership; no subscriptions or access expiration
Complete series bundle (€350) offers a €100 discount over individual purchases with pre-ordering for future levels
Team and organization licensing options available for companies equipping multiple developers

quotes.text: All recordings are DRM-free. No subscriptions, no expiring access. You bought it, you own it.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the ownership model and total cost of ownership, distinguishing it from subscription-based alternatives
